customer: Lost my car's title, I think. I'm in Virginia and need it for selling my EV. What do I do?
agent: Good news: Virginia uses electronic titles, so there's usually no paper title to lose. If you need a printed copy, you can request a duplicate title online from the Virginia motor vehicle agency, and it typically arrives in about a week. Bring the printout or the confirmation email to your appointment. You can find more in our article "Getting a duplicate title in Virginia."
